name: find_interactions
description: IntAct (EBI) molecular-interaction database — find protein-protein and other molecular interactions for a gene/protein (by name or UniProt id), with detection method, interaction type, organism, PubMed ref, and MI confidence score. Keyless.

query.description: Gene name, protein name, or UniProt accession (e.g. "EGFR_HUMAN", "BRCA2", "P04637").

name: interaction_count
description: IntAct (EBI) — fast count of how many molecular interactions a gene/protein (by name or UniProt id) has. Keyless.

query.description: Gene name, protein name, or UniProt accession (e.g. "EGFR_HUMAN", "BRCA2", "P04637").
